product.description: Read, edit, convert and render documents through the Aspose.Words object model.

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Compare a changed document with the original, Document.Compare, and write the redline: a copy of the original whose revisions are the differences.

commands.name: convert
commands.description: Convert a document to another format with the engine's options for it. An html, html-fixed or md output is one file: it holds its images, fonts and styles itself.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a document: the engine's new document, or a copy of a template saved in the output's format.

commands.name: edit
commands.description: Apply a batch of set, add, delete, move and do operations to a document; nothing is written when one fails.

commands.name: extract
commands.description: Write the bytes of each image the document stores, ImageData.ImageBytes, one file per image in document order; a linked image stores none.

commands.name: read
commands.description: Read a document's objects, each with every row of the object table, and its inventory.

commands.name: render
commands.description: Render one or more document pages.

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search the text of a document's paragraphs, as Paragraph.GetText() gives it; each hit names the paragraph's address.

v2/words/compare-command.description: Compare a changed document with the original, Document.Compare, and write the redline: a copy of the original whose revisions are the differences.

options.name: --author
options.description: The author of the redline's revisions, Document.Compare's author.

options.name: --date-time
options.description: The date and time of the redline's revisions, Document.Compare's dateTime, written yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Check the input, the output and the options, then stop without running the command or writing any file. A dry run that succeeds does not guarantee that the command succeeds.

options.name: --font-dir
options.description: Local font directory searched in addition to the system fonts; repeat for more.

options.name: --granularity
options.description: CompareOptions.Granularity, a member name of the engine's Granularity, such as WordLevel or CharLevel. Default: the engine's.

options.name: --ignore-case-changes
options.description: Set CompareOptions.IgnoreCaseChanges to true.

options.name: --ignore-comments
options.description: Set CompareOptions.IgnoreComments to true.

options.name: --ignore-fields
options.description: Set CompareOptions.IgnoreFields to true.

options.name: --ignore-footnotes
options.description: Set CompareOptions.IgnoreFootnotes to true.

options.name: --ignore-formatting
options.description: Set CompareOptions.IgnoreFormatting to true.

options.name: --ignore-headers-and-footers
options.description: Set CompareOptions.IgnoreHeadersAndFooters to true.

options.name: --ignore-tables
options.description: Set CompareOptions.IgnoreTables to true.

options.name: --ignore-textboxes
options.description: Set CompareOptions.IgnoreTextboxes to true.

options.name: --left-password
options.description: Password for the original document. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --left-password-env.

options.name: --left-password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the original document.

options.name: --left-password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the original document from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --out
options.description: The redline's path; its extension selects the format, such as .docx or .pdf.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

options.name: --right-password
options.description: Password for the changed document. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --right-password-env.

options.name: --right-password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the changed document.

options.name: --right-password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the changed document from the first line of stdin.

v2/words/compare-result.description: Result of words compare: the redline Document.Compare made of the original, and its revision count.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

revisionCount.description: The redline's revision count, Document.Revisions.Count after the comparison.

engineWarnings.description: The warnings Aspose.Words reported, as it reported them; omitted when there were none.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

v2/words/convert-command.description: Convert a document to another format with the engine's options for it. An html, html-fixed or md output is one file: it holds its images, fonts and styles itself.

options.name: --auto-numbering-detection
options.description: true or false: TxtLoadOptions.AutoNumberingDetection of a txt input. Required for such an input.

options.name: --detect-hyperlinks
options.description: true or false: TxtLoadOptions.DetectHyperlinks of a txt input. Required for such an input.

options.name: --detect-numbering-with-whitespaces
options.description: true or false: TxtLoadOptions.DetectNumberingWithWhitespaces of a txt input. Required for such an input.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Check the input, the output and the options, then stop without running the command or writing any file. A dry run that succeeds does not guarantee that the command succeeds.

options.name: --encoding
options.description: The text encoding of a txt or md input, such as utf-8, gb18030 or windows-1252 (LoadOptions.Encoding). Required for such an input.

options.name: --encrypt
options.description: Password for the output document. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --encrypt-env.

options.name: --encrypt-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the output document.

options.name: --encrypt-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the output document from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --font-dir
options.description: Local font directory searched in addition to the system fonts; repeat for more.

options.name: --leading-spaces
options.description: TxtLoadOptions.LeadingSpacesOptions of a txt input, a member name of the engine's TxtLeadingSpacesOptions, such as ConvertToIndent, Preserve or Trim. Required for such an input.

options.name: --out
options.description: Output path; defaults to a sibling using the target extension.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

options.name: --pages
options.description: Pages to process: 1-based numbers and ranges such as 1-3,7,9-, or all. Default: every page. Only with --to pdf, xps, openxps, ps, pcl or html-fixed.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the document. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the document.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the document from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --to
options.description: Target document format. Default: the --out extension's format. flatopc, wordml write .xml; openxps writes .oxps; html-fixed writes .html or .htm.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

outputs.description: The written files: the one file the document was converted to.

pages.description: The 1-based pages the output holds, as --pages selected them; absent for every page.

engineWarnings.description: The warnings Aspose.Words reported, as it reported them; omitted when there were none.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

wordsConvertOutput.description: The file a document was converted to.

path.description: Absolute path of the produced file.

format.description: Format id of the produced file, e.g. png.

encrypted.description: true when the produced file is encrypted and opens only with its password; omitted when its format cannot carry a password.

v2/words/ops.title: Object table operations
v2/words/ops.description: An edit's operations, applied in order to the document in memory; when one fails, nothing is written. Each kind's definition lists its addresses and rows, each add's and action's the engine call it makes.

address.description: An object's address: 'document' for the document itself, otherwise segments and keys from the document down, such as each kind's x-addresses shows. read gives every object's address. A form that starts with {kind} continues an address of an object of that kind, one of the kind's own forms. In a key that is a name, a / is written \/ and a \ is written \\.

set.description: Sets rows of the object at an address, in the order written; each row sets one engine member.
The address of the object whose rows are set.

props.description: The rows to set, by name, each in its kind's form; the definition of the addressed object's kind lists its rows.

add.description: Makes one engine call that creates an object, then sets rows of the new object.

delete.description: Deletes the object at an address.
The address of the object to delete.

move.description: Moves the object at an address to a position among its siblings.
The address of the object to move.

to.description: The position to move to, the engine's, from 0.

do.description: Makes one engine call on the whole document.

builtInDocumentProperties.words.description: Document.BuiltInDocumentProperties.Words: the count the file holds, which the update_word_count action recounts.

protectionType.description: Document.ProtectionType; the protect and unprotect actions change it.

watermark.type.description: Document.Watermark.Type; the watermark actions change it.

trackRevisions.description: Document.TrackRevisions: whether Microsoft Word tracks the changes made to the document.

section.description: A section of the document: Document.Sections[i].

pageSetup.orientation.description: Section.PageSetup.Orientation; the engine swaps the width and height when it changes.

pageSetup.textColumns.count.description: Section.PageSetup.TextColumns.Count; the set_column_count action changes it.

headerFooter.description: A header or footer of a section, a story: Section.HeadersFooters[HeaderFooterType]. A section without one of a type shows the previous section's.

isLinkedToPrevious.description: HeaderFooter.IsLinkedToPrevious: the engine gives true for one that holds no paragraph.

body.description: The main text of a section, a story: Section.Body.

layout.description: The document laid out on pages; read does not list it, --at layout reads it, and reading it makes the engine lay the document out.

pageCount.description: Document.PageCount: the engine lays the document out to count its pages.

range.description: The text of an object as one string, Node.Range; read does not list ranges, --at reads one.

text.description: Range.Text: the text with the engine's control characters, such as \r ending a paragraph, \a ending a cell, \u0013 \u0014 \u0015 around a field's code and result.

paragraph.description: A paragraph: its parent's paragraphs, GetChildNodes(NodeType.Paragraph, false)[i], which hold those in content controls.

text.description: Paragraph.GetText(): the paragraph's text with the engine's control characters, its deleted revisions and field codes included.

paragraphFormat.lineSpacing.description: Paragraph.ParagraphFormat.LineSpacing, in points; with the Multiple rule 12 is single spacing.

listFormat.list.description: Paragraph.ListFormat.List, by its ListId; null when the paragraph is no list item. Set to a list's ListId, found with ListCollection.GetListByListId; the remove_list_numbers action removes it.

listLabel.labelString.description: Paragraph.ListLabel.LabelString: as the engine last numbered it, which the update_list_labels action renumbers.

table.description: A table: its parent's Tables[i]. An empty table, or a row without cells, is not kept when the engine saves.

sdt.description: A content control, StructuredDocumentTag, at its place among its parent's children: around paragraphs and tables, runs, rows or cells. The engine's collections hold its content as the parent's own: read lists a paragraph in it as one of its parent's paragraphs, after the control, and its range holds the content's text. An add in a control, or an address below one, names the content by its position in the control, so the same paragraph has two addresses: read lists it by its place among the parent's paragraphs, and …/sdt/0/paragraph/1 names it in the control. A content control in a control is listed once, below the control that holds it (…/sdt/0/sdt/0): the engine's collections of content controls hold a node's direct ones only. A delete removes the control with its content, StructuredDocumentTag.Remove(); the remove_self_only action keeps the content.

run.description: A run of text with one formatting: its paragraph's runs, GetChildNodes(NodeType.Run, false)[i], which hold those in content controls. A paragraph without text has no run.

font.name.description: Run.Font.Name; setting it sets the ASCII, other and East Asian names alike, the engine's setter.

font.color.description: Run.Font.Color; null for the automatic color, Color.Empty.

field.description: A field: FieldStart.GetField() of the paragraph's own field starts, Paragraph.GetChildNodes(NodeType.FieldStart, false), in order. A field in a footnote, comment or text box anchored in the paragraph is listed below that story's paragraph, not this one.

result.description: Field.Result: as the engine last updated it; the update_fields and update_field actions update it.

headingLevelRange.description: FieldToc.HeadingLevelRange, such as 1-3. Only on FieldToc.

shape.description: A shape that is a paragraph's own child, such as a picture or a text box, whose paragraphs are below it.

row.description: A row of a table: Table.Rows[i].

cell.description: A cell of a row, a story: Row.Cells[i]. An empty cell holds one paragraph without a run.

comment.description: A comment, a story: the document's comments in document order, Document.GetChildNodes(NodeType.Comment, true)[i].

footnote.description: A footnote or endnote, a story: the document's in document order, Document.GetChildNodes(NodeType.Footnote, true)[i].

referenceMark.description: Footnote.ReferenceMark: empty for the automatic number.

text.description: Bookmark.Text: the text between its start and end; set, it replaces that text.

style.description: A style: Document.Styles[name], whose name matches with case. Font and ParagraphFormat are null on some types of style, and so are their rows.

font.name.description: Style.Font.Name; setting it sets the ASCII, other and East Asian names alike, the engine's setter.

font.color.description: Style.Font.Color; null for the automatic color, Color.Empty.

list.description: A list definition: Document.Lists.GetListByListId(listId); a paragraph's listFormat.list names it.

listLevel.description: A level of a list: List.ListLevels[i], from 0 to 8.

numberFormat.description: ListLevel.NumberFormat: the characters \u0000 to \u0008 stand for the numbers of levels 0 to 8.

revision.description: A tracked change: Document.Revisions[i]; the revision actions accept and reject it.

parentNode.text.description: Revision.ParentNode.GetText(): the text of the node the revision is on.

customProperty.description: A custom document property: Document.CustomDocumentProperties[name], whose name matches without case.

add.headerFooter.description: Adds a headerFooter to a section: new HeaderFooter(document, headerFooterType), then Section.HeadersFooters.Add; it holds no paragraph

in.description: The address of the section to add to.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new headerFooter to set after the call, as #/$defs/headerFooter lists them.

add.paragraph.description: Adds a paragraph to a body: new Paragraph(document), then CompositeNode.InsertBefore(paragraph, before); it holds no run, and its style is the engine's default, Normal. Adds a paragraph to a headerFooter: new Paragraph(document), then CompositeNode.InsertBefore(paragraph, before); it holds no run, and its style is the engine's default, Normal. Adds a paragraph to a comment: new Paragraph(document), then CompositeNode.InsertBefore(paragraph, before); it holds no run, and its style is the engine's default, Normal. Adds a paragraph to a footnote: new Paragraph(document), then CompositeNode.InsertBefore(paragraph, before); it holds no run, and its style is the engine's default, Normal. Adds a paragraph to a cell: new Paragraph(document), then CompositeNode.InsertBefore(paragraph, before); it holds no run, and its style is the engine's default, Normal. Adds a paragraph to a sdt: new Paragraph(document), then CompositeNode.InsertBefore(paragraph, before); it holds no run, and its style is the engine's default, Normal.

in.description: The address of the body, headerFooter, comment, footnote, cell or sdt to add to.

before.description: The child of in that the new object goes before; not given, it goes last (InsertBefore's refChild is null).

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new paragraph to set after the call, as #/$defs/paragraph lists them.

add.table.description: Adds a table to a body: new Table(document), then CompositeNode.InsertBefore(table, before); it holds no row, and the engine keeps no empty table when it saves. Adds a table to a headerFooter: new Table(document), then CompositeNode.InsertBefore(table, before); it holds no row, and the engine keeps no empty table when it saves. Adds a table to a comment: new Table(document), then CompositeNode.InsertBefore(table, before); it holds no row, and the engine keeps no empty table when it saves. Adds a table to a footnote: new Table(document), then CompositeNode.InsertBefore(table, before); it holds no row, and the engine keeps no empty table when it saves. Adds a table to a cell: new Table(document), then CompositeNode.InsertBefore(table, before); it holds no row, and the engine keeps no empty table when it saves. Adds a table to a sdt: new Table(document), then CompositeNode.InsertBefore(table, before); it holds no row, and the engine keeps no empty table when it saves.

in.description: The address of the body, headerFooter, comment, footnote, cell or sdt to add to.

before.description: The child of in that the new object goes before; not given, it goes last (InsertBefore's refChild is null).

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new table to set after the call, as #/$defs/table lists them.

add.run.description: Adds a run to a paragraph: new Run(document, text), then CompositeNode.InsertBefore(run, before); it takes the paragraph's formatting. Adds a run to a sdt: new Run(document, text), then CompositeNode.InsertBefore(run, before); it takes the paragraph's formatting.

in.description: The address of the paragraph or sdt to add to.

before.description: The child of in that the new object goes before; not given, it goes last (InsertBefore's refChild is null).

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new run to set after the call, as #/$defs/run lists them.

add.field.description: Adds a field to a paragraph: Paragraph.AppendField(fieldCode), which updates the new field, or Paragraph.AppendField(fieldCode, fieldValue), whose result is fieldValue; the field ends the paragraph

in.description: The address of the paragraph to add to.

fieldCode.description: The field's code, such as PAGE, TOC \o "1-3" \h or HYPERLINK "https://example.com".

fieldValue.description: The field's result as the document shows it until the field is updated.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new field to set after the call, as #/$defs/field lists them.

add.image.description: Adds a shape to a paragraph: DocumentBuilder.MoveTo(paragraph), then DocumentBuilder.InsertImage(bytes): an inline picture at the image's own size, at the end of the paragraph

in.description: The address of the paragraph to add to.

image.description: The image file the picture shows.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new shape to set after the call, as #/$defs/shape lists them.

add.row.description: Adds a row to a table: new Row(document), then CompositeNode.InsertBefore(row, before); it holds no cell, and the engine keeps no row without cells when it saves. Adds a row to a sdt: new Row(document), then CompositeNode.InsertBefore(row, before); it holds no cell, and the engine keeps no row without cells when it saves.

in.description: The address of the table or sdt to add to.

before.description: The child of in that the new object goes before; not given, it goes last (InsertBefore's refChild is null).

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new row to set after the call, as #/$defs/row lists them.

add.cell.description: Adds a cell to a row: new Cell(document), then CompositeNode.InsertBefore(cell, before); it holds no paragraph. Adds a cell to a sdt: new Cell(document), then CompositeNode.InsertBefore(cell, before); it holds no paragraph.

in.description: The address of the row or sdt to add to.

before.description: The child of in that the new object goes before; not given, it goes last (InsertBefore's refChild is null).

do.replace.description: Range.Replace(pattern, replacement, FindReplaceOptions) on the node's range: every match of the text, as the engine matches it. Returns the number of replacements.

replacement.description: The text it is replaced with.

node.description: The object whose Node.Range the call replaces in. Default: Document.Range, the whole document.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.replace_regex.description: Range.Replace(Regex pattern, replacement, FindReplaceOptions) on the node's range: every match of the .NET regular expression; $1 in the replacement is a group when FindReplaceOptions.UseSubstitutions is true. Returns the number of replacements.

replacement.description: The text each match is replaced with.

node.description: The object whose Node.Range the call replaces in. Default: Document.Range, the whole document.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.update_fields.description: Document.UpdateFields(): updates the result of every field; neither opening nor saving a document updates them. Returns nothing.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.update_page_layout.description: Document.UpdatePageLayout(): lays the document out again, which the page numbers of a later update_fields use. Returns nothing.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.update_list_labels.description: Document.UpdateListLabels(): numbers every list item again, which listLabel.labelString reads. Returns nothing.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.update_word_count.description: Document.UpdateWordCount(): counts the words, characters and paragraphs into the built-in document properties. Returns nothing.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.update_field.description: Field.Update(): updates the field's result. Returns the field's address.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.update_toc_page_numbers.description: FieldToc.UpdatePageNumbers(): updates the page numbers of a table of contents. Returns the engine's bool, whether it updated them, and the field's address.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.start_track_revisions.description: Document.StartTrackRevisions(author, dateTime), or StartTrackRevisions(author) without dateTime, whose revisions take the time they are made: the operations after it in the batch are recorded as revisions. Returns nothing.

dateTime.description: The date and time of the revisions.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.stop_track_revisions.description: Document.StopTrackRevisions(): the operations after it are not recorded as revisions. Returns nothing.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.accept_revision.description: Revision.Accept(): the revisions after it in Document.Revisions move up a position. Returns nothing.

do.reject_revision.description: Revision.Reject(): the revisions after it in Document.Revisions move up a position. Returns nothing.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.protect.description: Document.Protect(protectionType, password), or Document.Protect(protectionType) without passwordEnv. Returns nothing.

passwordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the password.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.unprotect.description: Document.Unprotect(password), or Document.Unprotect() without passwordEnv. Returns the engine's bool: false when the password is not the document's.

passwordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the password.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.set_text_watermark.description: Document.Watermark.SetText(text, TextWatermarkOptions), with the options given and the engine's defaults for the rest. Returns nothing.

fontSize.description: TextWatermarkOptions.FontSize, in points; 0 sizes it to the page.

isSemitrasparent.description: TextWatermarkOptions.IsSemitrasparent, as the engine spells it.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.set_image_watermark.description: Document.Watermark.SetImage(stream, ImageWatermarkOptions), with the options given and the engine's defaults for the rest. Returns nothing.

image.description: The image file the watermark shows.

scale.description: ImageWatermarkOptions.Scale; 0 sizes it to the page.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.append_document.description: Document.AppendDocument(source, importFormatMode): the source document's sections are added after the last. Returns nothing.

file.description: The document to append, in a format edit reads.

passwordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the password of that document.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.mail_merge.description: MailMerge.Execute(DataTable) over a table of strings made of fieldNames and rows, after MailMerge.CleanupOptions is set when given: the engine repeats the whole document once per record. Returns nothing.

rows.description: The data: one list of strings per record, in the order of fieldNames.

cleanupOptions.description: MailMerge.CleanupOptions, the members of the engine's MailMergeCleanupOptions to combine.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.mail_merge_regions.description: MailMerge.ExecuteWithRegions(DataTable) over a table of strings named tableName, made of fieldNames and rows, after MailMerge.CleanupOptions is set when given: the region TableStart:tableName to TableEnd:tableName repeats once per record. Returns nothing.

fieldNames.description: The names of the data's columns, which MERGEFIELD fields name.

rows.description: The data: one list of strings per record, in the order of fieldNames.

cleanupOptions.description: MailMerge.CleanupOptions, the members of the engine's MailMergeCleanupOptions to combine.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.clone.description: Node.Clone(isCloneChildren) of a node, then CompositeNode.InsertBefore(clone, before) on parent; the clone keeps the node's formatting, and with its children their bookmarks and comments too. Returns the clone's address.

parent.description: The node the clone goes into.

before.description: The child of parent the clone goes before; not given, it goes last (InsertBefore's refChild is null).

isCloneChildren.description: Whether the clone holds copies of the node's children, as Node.Clone takes it.

do.remove_self_only.description: StructuredDocumentTag.RemoveSelfOnly(): removes the content control and keeps its content in its place. Returns nothing.

do.remove_list_numbers.description: ListFormat.RemoveNumbers() of a paragraph: it is no list item any more. Returns the paragraph's address.

do.insert_break.description: DocumentBuilder.MoveTo(paragraph), which puts the cursor at the paragraph's end, then DocumentBuilder.InsertBreak(breakType); a section break starts a new section with an empty paragraph. Returns nothing.

paragraph.description: The paragraph at whose end the break goes.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.
The engine call's parameters, by name.

v2/words/read-command.description: Read a document's objects, each with every row of the object table, and its inventory.

options.name: --at
options.description: The address of the object to read with everything below it, as read gives it in at. Default: the whole document.

options.name: --from
options.description: The address of the object the window starts at; a truncated read's window.next gives it.

options.name: --kind
options.description: List only objects of this kind, one the ops schema lists; repeat for several. Default: every kind. Objects of the kinds paragraph, run, field, shape, row, cell, bookmark, style, listLevel, revision are listed only when --kind names them; window.notListedUnlessNamed names those a read left out.

options.name: --max-objects
options.description: The most objects one window lists. Range: 1-10000.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the document. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the document.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the document from the first line of stdin.

v2/words/read-result.description: Result of words read: a window of the document's objects in document order, each with every row of the table it has, and the whole document's inventory.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

window.description: The window of the read or search: how much it returned and the option values that continue it.

inventory.description: How many objects of each kind of content the document holds: under read the kinds read lists, under notRead the others.

engineWarnings.description: The warnings Aspose.Words reported while it loaded the document, as it reported them; omitted when there were none.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

objects.description: The objects of the window, in document order, each with its address, kind and rows; last, since it grows with the document.

v2/words/render-command.description: Render one or more document pages.

options.name: --dpi
options.description: Raster resolution; refused for vector output such as svg. Range: 36-1200.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Check the input, the output and the options, then stop without running the command or writing any file. A dry run that succeeds does not guarantee that the command succeeds.

options.name: --font-dir
options.description: Local font directory searched in addition to the system fonts; repeat for more.

options.name: --out
options.description: Output path. Default: the input path with the image extension. Several pages write <stem>.<page>.<ext> beside it.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

options.name: --pages
options.description: Pages to process: 1-based numbers and ranges such as 1-3,7,9-, or all. Default: every page; at most 20 per run.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the document. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the document.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the document from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --to
options.description: Image format. Default: the --out extension's format, else png.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

outputs.description: One written image per rendered page, in page order.

dpi.description: The raster resolution of png and jpeg output; absent for svg.

engineWarnings.description: The warnings Aspose.Words reported, as it reported them; omitted when there were none.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

wordsPageOutput.description: One rendered page and its image file.

path.description: Absolute path of the produced file.

format.description: Format id of the produced file, e.g. png.

encrypted.description: true when the produced file is encrypted and opens only with its password; omitted when its format cannot carry a password.

v2/words/search-command.description: Search the text of a document's paragraphs, as Paragraph.GetText() gives it; each hit names the paragraph's address.

options.name: --case-sensitive
options.description: Match letter case exactly.

options.name: --max-hits
options.description: Maximum returned hits. Range: 1-10000.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the document. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the document.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the document from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --pattern
options.description: Text to find, or a regular expression with --regex.

options.name: --regex
options.description: Treat the pattern as a culture-invariant regular expression with a one-second budget.

options.name: --skip
options.description: Matches to pass over before the returned hits; a truncated search's window.next sets it.

v2/words/search-result.description: Result of words search: the matches in the text rows of the document's objects.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

window.description: The window of the read or search: how much it returned and the option values that continue it.

engineWarnings.description: The warnings Aspose.Words reported while it loaded the document, as it reported them; omitted when there were none.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

hits.description: The hits in document order: the object's address, the text row, and where the match is in it; last, since it grows with the document.
